scale_pop.description: Text scales up quickly from 0.8x to 1.1x with a subtle spring bounce to grab immediate attention.

word_reveal_slide.description: Words slide up from a hidden clip-path container one by one in sync with voiceover cadence.

counter_count_up.description: Numbers rapidly increment from 0 or baseline value to target figure (e.g. $4.00 ➔ $1.60).

text_transform_highlight.description: Keyword text background highlights in vibrant green or yellow as voiceover pronounces it.
text_transform_highlight.best_for: Important terms like 'Eligible Order Amount', 'Nofollow Sponsored'
